title: Print Heading Outline Chip Bottom Border Alignment
description: Outline paragraph chips (e.g. Bauteilportal) still show verticals poking below the baseline and imperfect junctions with the connecting line. Solid/colored chips are fine. Follow-up: outline pair chips must open at the bottom onto a single shared baseline row instead of stacking chip-bottom + gap strokes.
summary: Root cause was TeX digit-gluing: 2\\semio@stroke@hairline expanded to 20.75pt (not 1.5pt), so outline chip top/bottom strokes were ~19.25pt wider than the mid verticals. Shared \\linewidth baseline then overshot the visible right edge (Bauteilportal). Fixed via \\semio@window@cap@outer@w = cap@w+hairline+hairline for closed and open outline frames; Needspace keep uses the same sum pattern. Probe raster: leftDelta=rightDelta=0 for Bauteilportal and Bauteilbörsen; BR corner flush.
